accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Active accounts first, then archived ones, each by name.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Balances per currency, including archived accounts. Currencies are never added together.

account_class.title: Account Class
account_class.description: `liability` for credit cards and loans, whose balance is negative while money is owed; `asset` for everything else. Investment accounts hold what was moved into them, not market value.

balance.title: Balance
balance.description: The opening balance plus every recorded transaction, in minor units. Positive is money held, negative is money owed.

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Archived accounts take no new transactions.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Current first, then archived, by name.

value.title: Value
value.description: The latest valuation, else the purchase cost, else 0.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: `current`; `stale` when the latest valuation is over a year old; `missing` without one.

excluded_reason.title: Excluded Reason
excluded_reason.description: Why net worth leaves it out, such as being already counted in a linked account's balance.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: The sum of asset accounts' balances, in minor units.

liabilities.title: Liabilities
liabilities.description: What credit cards and loans owe, as a positive amount in minor units.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Income categories first, then expense categories, each by name.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: A built-in category, which can be renamed but not deleted.

CloseDepositRequest.title: CloseDepositRequest
CloseDepositRequest.description:
Close at maturity or early. `amount` is everything received: above the principal is
interest income; below it, a loss.

monthly_emi.title: Monthly Emi
monthly_emi.description: Active loans' EMIs as a monthly average.

upcoming_bills.description: Expected bills due in the next 30 days.

due_this_month.description: Expected payments of any kind due from today to the end of the month.

type.title: Type
type.description: Loan accounts are created with a loan, not on their own.

opening_balance.title: Opening Balance
opening_balance.description: Minor units. Positive is money held, negative is money owed: a credit card with ₹500 outstanding is -50000.

linked_account_id.title: Linked Account Id
linked_account_id.description: A related account. An asset account (bank, cash, investment) means the asset is already counted in its balance, so net worth leaves the asset out.

CreateAssetRequest.title: CreateAssetRequest
CreateAssetRequest.description:
Track an asset valued by hand. `current_value` records its first valuation (on
`valued_on`, default today). Names are unique per workspace.

interest_rate_bps.title: Interest Rate Bps
interest_rate_bps.description: Annual interest rate in basis points: 7.1% is 710.

CreateDepositRequest.title: CreateDepositRequest
CreateDepositRequest.description:
Open a fixed deposit (`amount`: the principal) or a recurring deposit (`amount`: the
monthly installment). The first deposit is recorded on `start_date`, settled as given.

CreateHoldingRequest.title: CreateHoldingRequest
CreateHoldingRequest.description:
Add a mutual fund, stock, or ETF to an investment account. Units come from its buys; one
bought before Orbit is recorded as a buy with settlement `none`.

CreateInvestmentAccountRequest.title: CreateInvestmentAccountRequest
CreateInvestmentAccountRequest.description:
Track investments in an account: give `account_id` to use an existing finance account of
type `investment` (its history carries over), or `name` and `currency` for a new one.

outstanding_principal.title: Outstanding Principal
outstanding_principal.description: For a loan already being repaid: what is still owed. Defaults to `principal`.

interest_rate_bps.title: Interest Rate Bps
interest_rate_bps.description: Annual interest rate in basis points: 8.5% is 850.

interest_method.title: Interest Method
interest_method.description: `reducing`: interest on the outstanding balance (most loans). `flat`: interest on the original principal for the whole tenure.

next_payment_date.title: Next Payment Date
next_payment_date.description: For a loan already being repaid: the next installment's date. Defaults to `first_payment_date`.

emi_amount.title: Emi Amount
emi_amount.description: The lender's EMI. Defaults to the standard EMI for the terms.

CreateLoanRequest.title: CreateLoanRequest
CreateLoanRequest.description:
Track a loan. Orbit creates a `loan` account for it whose opening balance is the
outstanding principal (owed), and generates the installments still ahead.

amount_varies.title: Amount Varies
amount_varies.description: For bills like electricity: `amount` is an estimate.

CreateRecurringPaymentRequest.title: CreateRecurringPaymentRequest
CreateRecurringPaymentRequest.description: Track a subscription or a recurring bill. Its due dates repeat from `next_due_date`.

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: A task in the same workspace, or omit for a standalone one.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Defaults to the user's time zone preference, or UTC without one.

CreateTransactionRequest.title: CreateTransactionRequest
CreateTransactionRequest.description:
Record income, an expense, a refund, or a transfer. A transfer needs `to_account_id` and
has no category; the others have no `to_account_id`. The currency is the account's.

CreateTransferRequest.title: CreateTransferRequest
CreateTransferRequest.description:
Move money between two accounts in the same currency, such as paying a credit-card bill
or putting money into an investment account. Never income or spending.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.description: The widgets to show, in order. Each widget may appear once; an empty list is an empty dashboard.

size.title: Size
size.description: `half` widgets sit side by side on wide screens.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always `ok` when the database answered a query.

DatabaseHealthResponse.title: DatabaseHealthResponse
DatabaseHealthResponse.description: Reports that the configured database is reachable.

DepositContributionRequest.title: DepositContributionRequest
DepositContributionRequest.description: Record money put into the deposit: a recurring deposit's installment or a top-up.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.description: Active first, then by maturity date.

stated_maturity_amount.title: Stated Maturity Amount
stated_maturity_amount.description: The maturity amount the bank stated, if entered.

estimated_value.title: Estimated Value
estimated_value.description: Accrued value estimated from the rate and compounding. An estimate, not a guarantee.

projected_maturity_amount.title: Projected Maturity Amount
projected_maturity_amount.description: Estimated from the terms; a recurring deposit assumes every installment is paid on time.

DepositValueRequest.title: DepositValueRequest
DepositValueRequest.description: Set the deposit's value by hand (it replaces the estimate), or `value: null` to clear.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always `ok` when the API is serving requests.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Reports that the API process is running and able to serve requests.

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: A ticker, or a mutual fund's scheme code.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.description: The AMC or fund house for mutual funds.

category.title: Category
category.description: The scheme category, such as Flexi cap.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Cost basis of the units held (FIFO), excluding fees.

price.description: The latest price on or before today.

value.title: Value
value.description: `market_value`, or `cost` when there is no price.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: `current`; `stale` when the price is over 7 days old; `missing` without a price (valued at cost).

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: The installment's number within the loan's tenure.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Repays the loan: a transfer, never spending.

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: The cost of borrowing: an expense.

balance_after.title: Balance After
balance_after.description: Principal still owed after this installment: projected from the ledger while scheduled, as recorded once paid.

status.title: Status
status.description: `state` as of `today`: upcoming, due, or overdue.

adjusted.title: Adjusted
adjusted.description: Edited by hand rather than generated.

linked_account_id.title: Linked Account Id
linked_account_id.description: The account money usually comes from and returns to.

ledger_balance.title: Ledger Balance
ledger_balance.description: The finance account's balance: money moved in, plus income, minus fees and money moved out. Includes what was spent on holdings and deposits.

cash.title: Cash
cash.description: Uninvested cash: the ledger balance net of positions.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Buy: cost. Sell: gross proceeds. Dividend, interest: income. Fee: the charge. Deposit, withdrawal: the money moved.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: Charges on a buy or sale, recorded as a ledger expense.

cash_transaction_id.title: Cash Transaction Id
cash_transaction_id.description: The ledger transaction recording its cash: a transfer, income, or expense.

loans.title: Loans
loans.description: Active first, then closed, then archived, each by name.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: The loan's liability account. Its balance is the outstanding principal.

payment_account_id.title: Payment Account Id
payment_account_id.description: The account EMIs are usually paid from.

outstanding_principal.title: Outstanding Principal
outstanding_principal.description: What the loan account's balance says is still owed, derived from the ledger. Never stored.

total_installments.title: Total Installments
total_installments.description: Installments Orbit tracks: those still ahead when the loan was added, plus any added by rescheduling.

registration_open.title: Registration Open
registration_open.description: Whether a new local account can be created.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many notifications were marked read.

net.title: Net
net.description: Net cash flow: `income` minus `net_expenses`. Negative when more was spent than earned. Transfers never count.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Income, expense, and refund transactions counted.

net.title: Net
net.description: Net cash flow: `income` minus `net_expenses`. Negative when more was spent than earned. Transfers never count.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Income, expense, and refund transactions counted.

value.title: Value
value.description: What it adds to its side: a value, or what is owed.

source.title: Source
source.description: `ledger` (account balance), `market` (latest price), `manual` (entered by hand), `estimate` (computed from assumptions), or `cost` (no valuation).

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Every currency with accounts or assets. Never added together.

items.title: Items
items.description: Every account, holding, deposit, and asset behind the totals, including assets left out (`counted: false`).

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Against the snapshots 1, 3, 6, and 12 months back.

total.title: Total
total.description: Notifications matching the filters, across all pages.

unread.title: Unread
unread.description: All of the user's unread notifications.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: The workspace the reminder belongs to.

reminder_id.title: Reminder Id
reminder_id.description: The reminder that fired, or `null` once it has been deleted.

body.title: Body
body.description: The reminder's description when it fired; may be empty.

scheduled_for.title: Scheduled For
scheduled_for.description: When the reminder was scheduled to fire.

read_at.title: Read At
read_at.description: When it was first read, or `null` if unread.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: What was actually paid; defaults to the scheduled principal.

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: What was actually paid; defaults to the scheduled interest.

principal_transaction_id.title: Principal Transaction Id
principal_transaction_id.description: A transfer into the loan account.

PayInstallmentRequest.title: PayInstallmentRequest
PayInstallmentRequest.description:
Record an installment as paid. Either give `from_account_id`, and Orbit records the
principal as a transfer into the loan account and the interest as a "Loan interest" expense,
or link the transactions you already recorded.

occurrence_id.title: Occurrence Id
occurrence_id.description: The installment, or the settled occurrence. `null` for a subscription or bill payment that is still expected.

counterparty.title: Counterparty
counterparty.description: The lender or provider; may be empty.

estimated.title: Estimated
estimated.description: True for an expected bill whose amount varies.

snapshot.description: That month's snapshot; `null` when none was taken.

invested.title: Invested
invested.description: Cost of what is held now: FIFO cost plus deposits.

unrealized_gain.title: Unrealized Gain
unrealized_gain.description: Market value minus cost, for priced holdings.

realized_gain.title: Realized Gain
realized_gain.description: FIFO gains on sales in the date range.

income.title: Income
income.description: Dividends and interest in the date range.

return_percent.title: Return Percent
return_percent.description: `total_return` over everything ever invested, as a percentage with two decimals. Simple, not annualized; for display only.

price.title: Price
price.description: Per-unit price in the major unit, as a decimal string.

source.title: Source
source.description: `manual` today; others are reserved for imports.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: The investment account, for interest or fees not tied to a holding or deposit.

anyOf.description: Units as a decimal string with up to 6 decimals, such as `12.345`.

sip_plan_id.title: Sip Plan Id
sip_plan_id.description: Records this buy as an installment of that SIP.

sip_due_date.title: Sip Due Date
sip_due_date.description: The SIP date it settles; defaults to the next unrecorded one.

RecordInvestmentTransactionRequest.title: RecordInvestmentTransactionRequest
RecordInvestmentTransactionRequest.description:
Record a buy, sale, dividend, interest, fee, or deposit flow.

`settlement` says where the money is: `investment_account` (its own cash), `account` (another
account, `cash_account_id`; Orbit records the transfer, income, or expense there), or `none`
(buys and deposits only: from outside Orbit, such as a holding bought before it was tracked).
Dividends and interest are income; fees and `fees` on trades are expenses; buys and sales
are never income or spending.

price.title: Price
price.description: Per-unit price in the currency's major unit, as a decimal string with up to 6 decimals, such as `45.6789`.

RecordPriceRequest.title: RecordPriceRequest
RecordPriceRequest.description: Record a price (NAV or market price) by hand. A price already on that date is replaced.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: What was paid; defaults to the expected amount.

RecordRecurringPaymentRequest.title: RecordRecurringPaymentRequest
RecordRecurringPaymentRequest.description:
Record one occurrence as paid. `create` records an expense from `account_id` (default:
the usual account) in the subscription's or bill's category; `link` uses an expense already
recorded (`transaction_id`); `manual` marks it paid without a transaction, so it isn't
counted as spending.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Units as a decimal string with up to 6 decimals, such as `12.345`.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: The SIP date it settles; defaults to the next unrecorded one.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.description: Defaults to `account` with the SIP's funding account, else `investment_account`.

RecordSipInstallmentRequest.title: RecordSipInstallmentRequest
RecordSipInstallmentRequest.description:
Record one SIP installment as a buy. Amount defaults to the SIP's; the funding account,
when the SIP has one, settles it.

RecordValuationRequest.title: RecordValuationRequest
RecordValuationRequest.description: What the asset was worth on a date. A value already on that date is replaced.

weekdays.title: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Weekly only, and required for it: the days it repeats on.

RecurrenceModel.title: RecurrenceModel
RecurrenceModel.description:
How a reminder repeats. Monthly reminders on a day a month lacks (29 to 31) fire on that
month's last day.

recurring_payments.title: Recurring Payments
recurring_payments.description: Active first, then paused, then cancelled, each by name.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: The account it's usually paid from.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The expected amount; an estimate when `amount_varies`.

next_due_date.title: Next Due Date
next_due_date.description: The earliest unsettled due date, possibly overdue; `null` when nothing is expected (paused, cancelled, or past its end date).

monthly_cost.title: Monthly Cost
monthly_cost.description: `amount` as a monthly average, rounded half up.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `loan`, `recurring_payment` for a subscription or bill, or `deposit` for a fixed or recurring deposit's maturity.

total.title: Total
total.description: Reminders matching the filters, across all pages.

task.description: The task this reminder is about, or `null` for a standalone reminder.

commitment.description: The loan, subscription, or bill that manages this reminder. Such reminders follow its next payment and can't be edited or deleted here (409).

description.title: Description
description.description: Empty when the reminder has no description.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: The date of a one-time reminder, or the first date of a recurring one.

status.title: Status
status.description: `scheduled`: the next occurrence is ahead. `overdue`: one is due but not delivered yet, or the last delivery failed. `completed`: nothing left to fire, or the task is completed. `disabled`: switched off.

next_occurrence_at.title: Next Occurrence At
next_occurrence_at.description: When it next fires (UTC), possibly already due; `null` if it won't.

last_occurrence_at.title: Last Occurrence At
last_occurrence_at.description: The scheduled time of the most recent occurrence that was processed.

days_before.title: Days Before
days_before.description: 0 reminds on the due date itself.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Defaults to your time zone preference, else UTC.

ReminderSettingsRequest.title: ReminderSettingsRequest
ReminderSettingsRequest.description: Remind about each payment `days_before` its due date, at `time_of_day`.

anyOf.description: Annual interest rate in basis points: 8.5% is 850.

RescheduleLoanRequest.title: RescheduleLoanRequest
RescheduleLoanRequest.description:
Regenerate the unpaid installments from what is still owed, after a prepayment (a
transfer into the loan account) or a rate change. Without `emi_amount` the number of
installments stays the same and the EMI is recomputed; with it, the tenure changes.

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: The expense that recorded it; `null` when skipped or marked paid without a transaction (not counted as spending).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Empty when the item has no notes.

purchased_at.title: Purchased At
purchased_at.description: When the item was purchased, if it is.

items.title: Items
items.description: Needed items in the order they were added, then purchased items, most recently purchased first.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: The workspace's default list, which cannot be deleted.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: The workspace's default list, which cannot be deleted.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: The default list first, then the others in creation order.

next_due_date.title: Next Due Date
next_due_date.description: The first due date with no buy recorded; before today means overdue. Scheduled SIPs are not investments until a buy is recorded.

source.title: Source
source.description: `scheduled` (taken at month end), `manual` (the current month, saved by you), or `backfill` (a past month reconstructed later from history).

quality.description: How many counted values were estimates, manual, stale, or missing.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Largest net spending first. Categories whose refunds cancel their spending are left out.

database_path.title: Database Path
database_path.description: The SQLite file on the API's machine. Only in local mode, outside production.

can_reveal.title: Can Reveal
can_reveal.description: Whether the API can open the database's folder in the file manager.

StorageLocationResponse.title: StorageLocationResponse
StorageLocationResponse.description: Where this installation keeps its data, for signed-in users.

SupabaseAuthConfig.title: SupabaseAuthConfig
SupabaseAuthConfig.description: Public Supabase settings the web app needs to sign users in. Contains no secrets.

TakeSnapshotRequest.title: TakeSnapshotRequest
TakeSnapshotRequest.description:
Save a month's snapshot. Idempotent: a month that has one returns it (200) rather than
adding another. `refresh` recomputes the current month's; past months can't be refreshed.

total.title: Total
total.description: Tasks matching the filters, across all pages.

description.title: Description
description.description: Empty when the task has no description.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: A calendar date, without a time or time zone.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the task was completed, if it is.

total.title: Total
total.description: Transactions matching the filters, across all pages.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Minor units, always positive; `type` gives the direction.

occurred_on.title: Occurred On
occurred_on.description: A calendar date in the user's time zone.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Where income and refunds went in, expenses came out, or a transfer started.

months.title: Months
months.description: Oldest first, one per month, including months without transactions.

anyOf.description: Minor units. Positive is money held, negative is money owed: a credit card with ₹500 outstanding is -50000.

UpdateAccountRequest.title: UpdateAccountRequest
UpdateAccountRequest.description:
Change some of an account's fields. Its type and currency are fixed; archiving has its
own endpoints.

UpdateAssetRequest.title: UpdateAssetRequest
UpdateAssetRequest.description:
`null` clears the purchase details or the linked account. `archived: true` records it as
sold or disposed of; it stays as history but isn't counted.

anyOf.description: Annual interest rate in basis points: 7.1% is 710.

UpdateInstallmentRequest.title: UpdateInstallmentRequest
UpdateInstallmentRequest.description: Adjust a scheduled installment by hand.

UpdateInvestmentAccountRequest.title: UpdateInvestmentAccountRequest
UpdateInvestmentAccountRequest.description: `null` clears `linked_account_id`. `archived` archives or restores the finance account.

UpdateItemRequest.title: UpdateItemRequest
UpdateItemRequest.description:
Change some of an item's fields. Omitted fields keep their values; `quantity: null` and
`url: null` clear them. Purchasing has its own endpoints.

status.title: Status
status.description: `closed` when repaid or foreclosed, `archived` to hide it. Either stops expecting its scheduled installments; `active` resumes them.

UpdateLoanRequest.title: UpdateLoanRequest
UpdateLoanRequest.description:
Change a loan's details or status. `payment_account_id: null` and `reminder: null`
clear them. Rate and EMI changes go through `/reschedule`.

UpdateProfileRequest.title: UpdateProfileRequest
UpdateProfileRequest.description:
Change some profile fields. Omitted fields keep their values; `timezone: null` clears
the time zone preference.

UpdateRecurringPaymentRequest.title: UpdateRecurringPaymentRequest
UpdateRecurringPaymentRequest.description:
Change some fields; `null` clears `category_id`, `account_id`, `end_date`,
`trial_ends_on`, or `reminder`. `state` pauses (`paused`), cancels (`cancelled`), or resumes
(`active`) it; history is always kept. Changing `frequency` or `next_due_date`, or resuming,
restarts the schedule.

UpdateReminderRequest.title: UpdateReminderRequest
UpdateReminderRequest.description:
Change some of a reminder's fields. Omitted fields keep their values; `task_id: null`
detaches the task and `recurrence: null` makes the reminder one-time. Changing the schedule
or `enabled` replaces the pending occurrence.

UpdateSipPlanRequest.title: UpdateSipPlanRequest
UpdateSipPlanRequest.description:
`state` pauses, cancels, or resumes (`active`) the SIP. `null` clears `end_date` or
`funding_account_id`.

UpdateTaskRequest.title: UpdateTaskRequest
UpdateTaskRequest.description:
Change some of a task's fields. Omitted fields keep their values; `due_date: null` clears
the due date. Completion has its own endpoints.

UpdateTransactionRequest.title: UpdateTransactionRequest
UpdateTransactionRequest.description:
Correct some of a transaction's fields. Omitted fields keep their values;
`category_id: null` and `to_account_id: null` clear them. The result must follow the same
rules as a new transaction, so turning a transfer into an expense also clears
`to_account_id`.

auth_provider.title: Auth Provider
auth_provider.description: `local` (an account on this installation) or `supabase` (Supabase Auth).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, used by default for new reminders; `null` until they choose one.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Workspaces the user can access, the personal workspace first.

is_personal.title: Is Personal
is_personal.description: The default workspace created with the account.

role.title: Role
role.description: The signed-in user's role in the workspace.

HTTPBearer.description: A local session token (local mode) or a Supabase access token (cloud mode).
